mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 5.25% in a month triggers a risk-off reaction that compresses equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in a single month
regime_hint: high inflation or policy tightening anticipation
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the identified trigger period, or FEDFUNDS does not cross the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) above 136,000 for two consecutive months predicts stronger consumer demand, resulting in positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the two-month strong labor period.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDPC1 (real private consumption) by more than 2% in a quarter is associated with reduced future equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negatively correlated with GDPC1 declines (Pearson > -0.2) or IC < 0.05 over the quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 99.0 signals supply-side weakness that amplifies equity valuation discounts, yielding negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 99.0 periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE above 7.0% indicate a dual inflation and policy response that reduces growth expectations and produces negative 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 7.0% AND UNRATE > 7.0% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the interaction window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in HOUST (housing starts) above 900K in a month signals renewed construction optimism, which supports consumer confidence and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 900K in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the trigger month.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged monthly decline in RSAFS (retail sales) by 10% or more indicates weak consumer demand, which amplifies equity discounting and results in negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negatively correlated with RSAFS declines (Pearson > 0.1) or IC > 0.05 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent CPIAUCSL inflation above 233 (current level), a 0.25 percentage point increase in FEDFUNDS leads to negative 20-day forward returns via reduced growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 233 AND FEDFUNDS increases by 0.25% in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when the trigger is met in high-inflation regime.
